answer.question: What does TEAM International do for telecom companies?
answer.text: TEAM International is a telecom software development company that modernizes and extends the systems telecom providers run on: OSS/BSS, billing, ordering, CRM and customer portals. Since 2011 we have built and supported telecom software for operators such as Telenor Denmark and BullsEye Telecom, with dedicated teams working in North American and European time zones.
answer.segmentsIntro: Telecom IT services for mid-size providers that need enterprise-grade engineering, and for large operators that need a long-term team.

focus.title: Telecom IT solutions we build
focus.intro: Our IT services for telecom industry providers focus on the four areas where telecom software solutions most often slow them down.

items.title: OSS/BSS modernization and integration
items.text: Modernize OSS BSS solutions without stopping the business: middleware, quoting and ordering, telecom billing solutions and telecom CRM integration (Salesforce included), connected by APIs to carriers and third-party platforms.

items.title: Digital channels and self-service
items.text: Telecom application development for web shops, customer portals and mobile apps that move routine requests to self-service and improve telecom customer experience.

items.title: Telecom data analytics
items.text: Normalize KPIs that arrive from different carriers and systems into one trusted model for orders, revenue, churn and network reporting.

items.title: Telecom software testing and production support
items.text: Regression testing, configuration management and production support that keep releases stable across billing, ordering and customer-facing applications.

solutions.title: How every TEAM solution applies to telecom
solutions.intro: One partner for telecom technology solutions across the stack: each of our five solutions has a direct use for telecom providers.

items.name: AI-Powered Product & Software Engineering

steps.title: How a telecom engagement works
steps.intro: Every engagement starts with an assessment, so the roadmap is based on your systems, not on a template.

items.title: Telecom Discovery & Modernization Assessment
items.text: We map your OSS/BSS landscape, integrations, data flows and release pain points with your team.
items.outcome: A clear picture of what to modernize, integrate or leave alone

items.title: Prioritized roadmap
items.text: We rank initiatives by business impact, risk and effort, and agree on success metrics.

items.title: Dedicated team set-up
items.text: We staff a team with the telecom, engineering and QA skills the roadmap needs, in your time zone.
items.outcome: One accountable team that knows your systems

items.title: Build, integrate and test
items.text: We deliver in short releases with regression testing and configuration management built in.

items.title: Run and improve
items.text: We provide production support and track the KPIs agreed in step 2.
items.outcome: Measurable progress you can report on

delivery.title: Your language, your market, your time zone
delivery.text: North American providers work with our Medellín delivery center; European providers work with our teams in Ukraine, where Telenor Denmark's dedicated development center started. All locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we work under GDPR.

items.q: What does a telecom software development company do?
items.a: A telecom software development company designs, builds, integrates and supports the software telecom providers run on: OSS/BSS, billing, ordering, CRM, customer portals and mobile apps. TEAM International does this for operators, MVNOs and ISPs, and has done so for Telenor Denmark since 2011.

items.q: What telecom software development services does TEAM International offer?
items.a: Four areas: OSS/BSS modernization and integration, digital channels and self-service (we are a telecom app development company for web and mobile), telecom data analytics, and telecom software testing with production support.

items.q: Can you modernize OSS/BSS without replacing our billing platform?
items.a: Yes. Most engagements extend and integrate what already works, such as billing, CRM and ordering systems, through APIs and middleware, and replace only the components that block growth. The assessment decides which is which.

items.q: Do you work with MVNOs and ISPs, or only large operators?
items.a: Both. We focus on mid-size providers, including MVNOs and ISPs, and keep enterprise proof from operators such as Telenor Denmark.

items.q: Which telecom companies has TEAM International worked with?
items.a: Published examples include Telenor Denmark (a dedicated development center since 2011 that grew to more than 100 people) and BullsEye Telecom in the United States (API integrations, order processing and KPI reporting).

items.q: How does AI fit into telecom digital transformation?
items.a: AI in telecom only works on clean, connected data. McKinsey (February 2025) reports that less than 50% of operators have data quality good enough for gen AI use cases, so we start with data readiness and then add AI to engineering, operations and customer care.

items.q: How do you handle time zones and language?
items.a: Your team works in your language and your time zone: North America from our Medellín delivery center, Europe from Ukraine.

With a Telecom Discovery & Modernization Assessment. From there you choose a dedicated team or project delivery; telecom software outsourcing with TEAM means one accountable team, not a pool of contractors.
